proposals.observed_pattern: Recent change-loop evidence shows a repeated unstable review handoff: 3 of the 5 completed full-stack observations in data/agent_evals/change/review_promotion.json were corrected after ready, and the two latest 30-day outcome reports both called out post-ready instability or missing post-ready required-check executions around the review boundary.

suggested_policy_change.summary: Add a stable-ready requirement before any future selective-review promotion or auto-review decision can treat a PR as handoff-complete.
details: Require the current head SHA to match the SHA present when the PR most recently entered ready_for_review.
Require at least one required check execution on or after that most recent ready_for_review transition before a class can be counted as promotion-ready or eligible for automated review handling.
Treat any post-ready head change or missing post-ready required-check execution as review-required until a maintainer-owned policy change deliberately allows otherwise.

proposals.expected_benefit: This narrows promotion and auto-review candidates to PRs that have actually stabilized at handoff, reducing the repeated 'ready too early' miss pattern without broadening the allowlist.
risks: Some otherwise-safe PRs may stay in review-required longer if checks finish before the final ready_for_review event.
Timeline or check-attribution edge cases could undercount eligible PRs until the evaluation logic is hardened.
proposals.rollback: Drop the stable-ready gate and return to the current promotion/auto-review criteria if it materially increases false negatives or proves too sensitive to GitHub timeline quirks.
eval_cases_needed_before_promotion: A draft-born Copilot PR that changes after its first ready_for_review event must remain review-required until a new ready_for_review event occurs on the final head and a required check runs afterward.
A PR whose last required check completed before the final ready_for_review event must remain review-required and must not count as a successful promotion observation.
A stable PR with no post-ready head changes and a passing required check after the final ready_for_review event must still remain eligible for promotion evaluation.
Historical outcome replay should show that PRs #421, #424, and #425 fail the stable-ready gate, while PR #429 fails specifically for missing an executed post-ready required check.
